units.literal: I have been content to rely on the work of commentary and evaluation, hoping not to leave shame to later generations; what still vexes me is only that my late parents' tombs are not yet finished, that the many books I love are mostly decayed, and that I cannot copy them to completion in the ritual hall and transmit them to the right hands.

units.zh: 日西方暮，其可圖乎！
units.en: The sun is low—what time is left to plan!
units.literal: The sun is in the west and evening comes—can it still be planned for!

units.zh: 家今差多於昔，勤力務時，無恤饑寒。
units.en: We are a little better off than once; work the seasons hard and do not brood on want.
units.literal: The household is now somewhat better off than before; work hard at the seasons and do not fret over hunger and cold.

units.zh: 菲饑食，薄衣服，節夫二者，尚令吾寡恨。
units.en: Plain food and spare clothing, if you hold to both, will leave me little to regret.
units.literal: Eat frugally when hungry, clothe thinly—moderate these two, and you will still leave me with few regrets.

units.zh: 若忽忘不識，亦已焉哉！
units.en: If you forget all this, then we are done talking.
units.literal: If you heedlessly forget and do not understand, then so be it!

units.zh: 時，大將軍袁紹總兵冀州，遣使要玄，大會賓客，玄最後至，乃延升上坐。
units.en: Yuan Shao of Ji invited him to a great banquet; Zheng Xuan came last and was shown to the highest seat.
units.literal: At that time the general-in-chief Yuan Shao commanded troops in Ji province, sent an envoy to invite Xuan, and held a great assembly of guests; Xuan arrived last and was then led up to the seat of honor.

units.zh: 身長八尺，飲酒一斛，秀眉明目，容儀溫偉。
units.en: He stood eight feet, could drain a hu of wine at one sitting, had fine brows and clear eyes, and a warm, commanding presence.
units.literal: He was eight feet tall, drank a hu of wine at a sitting, had elegant brows and bright eyes, and his bearing was mild and imposing.

units.zh: 紹客多豪俊，並有才說，見玄儒者，未以通人許之，競設異端，百家互起。
units.en: Yuan's guests were swaggering debaters who, seeing a mere Ru, denied him mastery and tried every paradox from every school.
units.literal: Shao's guests were mostly bold and outstanding, all possessed of talent and argument; seeing Xuan as a mere scholar, they did not grant him the status of a thorough man of the world, vied to pose strange positions, and the hundred schools rose against one another.

units.zh: 玄依方辯對，咸出問表，皆得所未聞，莫不嗟服。
units.en: Zheng Xuan met each challenge on its own terms, outpaced every question, and said what none had heard; they gasped in admiration.
units.literal: Xuan answered each according to its proper category, all went beyond the questions, and all obtained what they had never heard; none did not sigh in admiration.

units.zh: 時汝南應劭亦歸於紹，因自贊曰：『故太山太守應中遠，北面稱弟子何如？』
units.en: Ying Shao of Runan, also Yuan's client, boasted: "I am Ying Zhongyuan, late prefect of Taishan—may I face north as your disciple?"
units.literal: At that time Ying Shao of Runan also had attached himself to Shao and therefore praised himself, saying: 'The former grand administrator of Taishan Ying Zhongyuan—how would it be to face north and call myself disciple?'

units.zh: 玄笑曰：『仲尼之門考以四科，回、賜之徒不稱官閥。』
units.en: Zheng Xuan smiled: "Confucius tested disciples in four arts; men like Yan Hui and Duanmu Ci never traded on their offices."
units.literal: Xuan smiled and said: 'At Confucius's gate the examination used four categories; disciples such as Hui and Ci did not proclaim official pedigrees.'

units.zh: 劭有慚色。
units.en: Ying Shao colored with embarrassment.
units.literal: Ying Shao had a shamefaced look.

units.zh: 紹乃舉玄茂才，表為左中郎將，皆不就。
units.en: Yuan Shao then nominated him flourishing talent and recommended him as general of the household for the left; Zheng Xuan refused both.
units.literal: Shao thereupon recommended Xuan as flourishing talent and memorialized him as general of the household for the left, but in neither case did he accept.

units.zh: 公車征為大司農，給安車一乘，所過長吏送迎。
units.en: The court coach summoned him as grand minister of agriculture with a single cushioned carriage and escort from every magistrate along the way.
units.literal: The summons coach summoned him as grand minister of agriculture, gave him one comfortable carriage, and the senior officials along the route saw him off and welcomed him.

units.zh: 玄乃以病自乞還家。
units.en: He pleaded illness and went home.
units.literal: Xuan thereupon pleaded illness on his own behalf and begged to return home.

units.zh: 五年春，夢孔子告之曰：『起，起，今年歲在辰，來年歲在巳。』
units.en: In the fifth year's spring he dreamed Confucius said: "Up, up—the year-star stands in chen this year, in si the next."
units.literal: In the spring of the fifth year he dreamed that Confucius told him: 'Rise, rise; this year the year-star is in chen, next year it will be in si.'

units.zh: 既寤，以讖合之，知命當終，有頃寢疾。
units.en: Awake, he read the weft-texts and knew his end was near; soon he took to his bed.
units.literal: When he awoke he matched it to the prognostications, knew his fate was to end, and before long fell ill in bed.

units.zh: 時袁紹與曹操相拒於官度，令其子譚遣使逼玄隨軍，不得已，載病到元城縣，疾篤不進，其年六月卒，年七十四。
units.en: While Yuan Shao and Cao Cao faced off at Guandu, Yuan Tan sent men to drag him to camp; he yielded, rode sick to Yuancheng, could go no farther, and died there that sixth month at seventy-four.
units.literal: At that time Yuan Shao and Cao Cao faced each other at Guandu; he ordered his son Tan to send an envoy to force Xuan to accompany the army; unable to avoid it, he carried his illness to Yuancheng county, grew too gravely ill to advance, and in the sixth month of that year died at age seventy-four.

units.zh: 遺令薄葬。
units.en: His testament called for a simple funeral.
units.literal: He left instructions for a plain burial.

units.zh: 自郡守以下嘗受業者，缞绖赴會千餘人。
units.en: Over a thousand former pupils, from prefects on down, came in hemp mourning.
units.literal: From grand administrators downward, those who had once been his disciples, more than a thousand came in mourning cord to the assembly.

units.zh: 門人相與撰玄答諸弟子問《五經》，依《論語》作《鄭誌》八篇。
units.en: His students collected his replies on the Five Classics and, on the model of the Analects, produced the Zheng zhi in eight chapters.
units.literal: The disciples together compiled Xuan's answers to disciples' questions on the Five Classics and, following the Analects, made the Zheng zhi in eight chapters.

units.zh: 凡玄所註《周易》、《尚書》、《毛詩》、《儀禮》、《禮記》、《論語》、《孝經》、《尚書大傳》、《中候》、《乾象歷》，又著《天文七政論》、《魯禮禘祫義》、《六藝論》、《毛詩譜》、《駁許慎五經異義》、《答臨孝存周禮難》，凡百餘萬言。
units.en: All told he glossed the Changes, Documents, Mao Odes, Ceremonial, Book of Rites, Analects, Filial Piety, Amplified Documents, Zhong hou, and the Qian xiang calendar, and wrote treatises on the seven celestial governors, the Lu ritual meaning of di and xia, the six arts, the Mao ode stemma, a refutation of Xu Shen's divergent glosses, and a reply to Lin Xiaocun's Zhou li critique—well over a million characters.
units.literal: In all, Xuan's commentaries on the Zhou yi, Documents, Mao Odes, Ceremonial, Record of Rites, Analects, Classic of Filial Piety, Amplified Documents, Zhong hou, Qian xiang calendar, and moreover his compositions Astronomical treatise on the seven governors, Lu ritual meaning of di and xia, Treatise on the six arts, Mao ode genealogy, Refutation of Xu Shen's meanings of the five classics diverging, and Answer to Lin Xiaocun's objections to the Rites of Zhou—altogether over a million graphs.

units.zh: 玄質於辭訓，通人頗譏其繁。
units.en: Critics found his glosses plain but wordy.
units.literal: Xuan was plain in diction and gloss, and thorough men of the world rather ridiculed his verbosity.

units.zh: 至於經傳洽孰，稱為純儒，齊、魯間宗之。
units.en: On mastery of canon and commentary he was judged a pure Ru, and Qi and Lu bowed to him.
units.literal: As for his thorough mastery of the classics and commentaries, he was called a pure scholar, and between Qi and Lu they took him as their authority.

units.zh: 其門人山陽郗慮至禦史大夫，東萊王基、清河崔琰著名於世。
units.en: His pupils included Xi Lu of Shanyang, who reached imperial counsellor, and Wang Ji of Donglai and Cui Yan of Qinghe, who became famous.
units.literal: Among his disciples Xi Lu of Shanyang rose to imperial counsellor, Wang Ji of Donglai and Cui Yan of Qinghe became famous in the world.

units.zh: 又樂安國淵、任嘏，時並童幼，玄稱淵為國器，嘏有道德，其餘亦多所鑒拔，皆如其言。
units.en: As boys, Guo Yuan of Le'an and Ren Gu drew his praise—Yuan a state vessel, Gu a moral nature—and his other judgments likewise proved true.
units.literal: Moreover Guo Yuan of Le'an and Ren Gu were at that time still in childhood; Xuan called Yuan a vessel of the state and Gu possessed of virtue; as for the rest he also appraised and promoted many, and all turned out as he said.

units.zh: 玄唯有一子益恩，孔融在北海，舉為孝廉；
units.en: His only son Yi'en was recommended filial and honest while Kong Rong governed Beihai;
units.literal: Xuan had only one son, Yi'en; when Kong Rong was in Beihai he recommended him as filial and incorrupt;

units.zh: 及融為黃巾所圍，益恩赴難損身。
units.en: when Kong Rong was trapped by the Turbans, Yi'en rushed to help and was killed.
units.literal: when Rong was besieged by the Yellow Turbans, Yi'en went to his rescue and lost his life.

units.zh: 有遺腹子，玄以其手文似己，名之曰小同。
units.en: A posthumous child was born; Zheng Xuan, seeing palm lines like his own, named the boy Xiaotong.
units.literal: There was a posthumous child; Xuan because the lines on his hand resembled his own named him Xiaotong.

units.zh: 論曰：自秦焚《六經》，聖文埃滅。
units.en: The historian writes: Qin's burning of the Six Classics left the sages' words in ash.
units.literal: The judgment says: From the time Qin burned the Six Classics, the sage texts were dust and extinction.

units.zh: 漢興，諸儒頗修藝文；
units.en: Han brought scholars who began to restore the canon;
units.literal: When Han arose, the various scholars somewhat restored the arts and documents;

units.zh: 及東京，學者亦各名家。
units.en: by the Eastern Han each school claimed its own master.
units.literal: by Eastern Capital times, students too each became masters in their own names.

units.zh: 而守文之徒，滯固所稟，異端紛紜，互相詭激，遂令經有數家，家有數說，章句多者或乃百餘萬言，學徒勞而少功，後生疑而莫正。
units.en: Literalists clung to sect, schools crossed swords, every classic spawned rival houses and every house rival glosses—some running to a million characters—so students labored without profit and youth had no touchstone.
units.literal: Yet those who clung to the letter, stuck in what they had received, with divergent doctrines tangled and mutually provoking, thereupon let the classics have several houses and each house several explanations, and in some cases glosses ran to over a million graphs—disciples toiled with little gain, and the young doubted and had no standard.

units.zh: 鄭玄括囊大典，網羅眾家，刪裁繁誣，刊改漏失，自是學者略知所歸。
units.en: Zheng Xuan gathered the great texts, sifted every school, cut bombast and error, and gave scholars a compass.
units.literal: Zheng Xuan gathered the great canons into a bag, netted the many houses, pruned the excessive and false, corrected omissions and errors, and from this scholars had a rough idea where to turn.

units.zh: 王父豫章君每考先儒經訓，而長於玄，常以為仲尼之門不能過也。
units.en: Fan Ye's grandfather, the lord of Yuzhang, collated earlier masters' glosses and always put Zheng Xuan first, convinced that even Confucius's school did not outrank him.
units.literal: My paternal grandfather the Lord of Yuzhang whenever he examined the glosses of former scholars on the classics always ranked Xuan above them and constantly held that not even Confucius's gate could surpass him.

units.zh: 及傳授生徒，並專以鄭氏家法云。
units.en: When he taught pupils himself, he followed only the Zheng method.
units.literal: When in turn he instructed students, he used exclusively the Zheng family method.

units.zh: 贊曰：富平之緒，承家載世。
units.en: The verse says: Fuping's line, handed down age after age.
units.literal: The encomium says: The thread of Fuping, inheriting the house through generations.

units.zh: 伯仁先歸，厘我國祭。
units.en: Boren returned first and straightened the dynastic cult.
units.literal: Boren came home first and set our state sacrifices in order.

units.zh: 玄定義乖，褒修禮缺。
units.en: Zheng Xuan set wandering glosses right; Cao Bao patched missing rite.
units.literal: Xuan fixed meanings where they had gone astray; Bao repaired what ritual lacked.

units.zh: 孔書遂明，漢章中輟。
units.en: Confucius's canon grew clear; Han's code stalled halfway.
units.literal: The writings of Kong grew clear; Han's statutes halted midway.
